subject: general
question:
**“The guests left the old woman with a sense of relief at having performed a vexatious duty”.**

**The duty is described as vexatious because: **

options.text: the guests were not happy when they finally left the aunt
it was quite pleasing to the guests
the guests were happy to have completed the assigned duty
it was a duty they found quite annoying

solution:
The correct answer is: **it was a duty they found quite annoying**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• It is said in the first sentence of the third paragraph of the given passage, "*And each visitor, though politeness prevented his showing impatience, left the old woman with a sense of relief __at having performed a vexatious duty and __did not return to her the whole evening.__* "
 
• The unlined part of the sentence explains that The guest was relieved when they left the old woman because they were not interested in her.
 
• So it is clear that The duty is described as vexatious because it was a duty they found quite annoying.

Hence, the correct answer is option 4.
